Name: Krobus Bowl-Cut Sprite
Author: kiwibrie
Description:
This mod replaces Krobus's in-game sprite with an alternate sprite that more closely matches Bowl-Cut Humanoid Krobus from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759]Gigi's Hi-Res Portraits[/url].

[b]**[/b] This mod [i]does not[/i] contain a KrobusRaven sprite. Future updates (if any) to this mod may include it, but as it stands at upload (version 1.0), [u]this mod is incomplete for Stardew Valley 1.5[/u]. This mod [i]can[/i] be used in conjunction with other Krobus sprite mods, but hierarchy conflicts will occur. [b]**[/b]

[b][u]How to Install:[/u][/b]
1. Install the most recent version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install the most recent version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Unzip into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder
4. Run Stardew Valley using SMAPI
